reason: Reproduced verbatim at 1440 on tasks.board: focus card, Space ("Picked up Confirm marquee sides with the hire company."), ArrowRight x2, Space -> "...dropped in the review column.", then Ctrl+Z -> "Nothing left to undo." and the card stays in Review; the same move by drag and by the card's Move menu both answer "...is back in the to do column.", and a keyboard drop into Done is undoable because completed() arms. Cause is exactly as stated at src/tasks.js:2884-2889 (the non-Done branch only calls say()), while the pointer path at :3687 and the menu path at :3460 both arm({kind:"move"}); interaction-check.mjs asserts nothing about carry undo, so no gate covers it, and the card advertises aria-roledescription="Movable task" plus aria-keyshortcuts for exactly this gesture.
sharpenedFix: Do not capture heldSince/completedAt at the drop as proposed — moveTo() calls applyLaneFacts() unconditionally on every preview move, so the arrow walk has already nulled them by the time Space commits (this is the very failure the comment at src/tasks.js:3684-3686 records). Capture at PICKUP instead: in the else branch of the Space handler write carriedFrom = { lane: laneIds()[at.x], index: at.y, wasHeldSince: t.heldSince, wasCompletedAt: t.completedAt }, then in the drop branch pass those through to arm({kind:"move", id, title, lane: carriedFrom.lane, index: carriedFrom.index, toLane: lane, wasHeldSince: carriedFrom.wasHeldSince, wasCompletedAt: carriedFrom.wasCompletedAt}). Also mirror the pointer path's two other laws at src/tasks.js:3663-3667 and :3691-3694: skip arming (and the sentence) when the drop lands on the pickup lane+index, since a pick-up-and-put-back is a non-event, and do not announce an index in a sorted lane.
